title: Bloodline Choice
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the complete Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with unprecedented radiance, and within that light was reflected the third possibility that even the Eye of Heavenly Way had never anticipated—

text.content: Dust from ten thousand years ago drifted slowly through the Tianji Record space. Chen Ji stood before the fragmented inscription, his fingertips gently brushing over the characters eroded by time. Mister Mo's words still echoed in his ears—"The Third Possibility." He closed his eyes, and countless images flooded his mind: Mister Mo's deep eyes in his residual soul state, Chen Tianming's trembling hands gripping his own with desperate strength in his final moments, and his sister Chen Nian's despairing yet hopeful gaze as she was taken away. All of this wove together into a massive web of fate, with him standing at its center.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, do you know that since the moment of its birth, the Tianji Record was meant to allow mortals to glimpse heavenly secrets and change their fate? Yet without exception, every successor throughout the ages has become a piece on Heaven's chessboard—either assimilated by the Heavenly Way, becoming a new puppet; or erased by the Heavenly Way, turning to dust in history.

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes and gazed at the two options gradually emerging on the inscription. One path led to the Heavenly Way—replacement, becoming the new sovereign, grasping fate in his own hands. The other path led to freedom—breaking the chains, transcending completely beyond the Heavenly Way, carving out a path belonging to mortals. Both paths were strewn with thorns, and he had to make a choice.

dialogue.content: Mister Mo, what is this third possibility you spoke of...? Chen Ji's voice echoed through the empty space, but there was no answer. Mister Mo's residual soul had fallen into slumber, leaving only that yellowed ancient book resting quietly in his palm.

text.content: Just then, the characters on the inscription began to vibrate violently. The first path emanated a crimson glow—that was the color of power, the throne watered by countless streams of blood. The second path flickered with silver-white brilliance, pure and lonely, as if leading to an eternal shore. Chen Ji felt a wave of dizziness as information from both paths flooded into his mind like a torrent.

dialogue.content: (Mister Mo's residual voice rang in Chen Ji's mind) The first path, replacing the Heavenly Way—you will become the new Heavenly Way consciousness, controlling the life and death of all things, but the price is you will lose all human emotions and memories, becoming an eternal and lonely existence. The second path, breaking the chains—you will transcend beyond the Heavenly Way, no longer bound by fate, but you will wander eternally in the Void, becoming a ghost accepted by no world.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly. He thought of the disciples of Tianqing Sect who had mocked him, of Han Lie's insufferable arrogance, of Ling Yuan's fox-like killing intent hidden beneath apparent kindness. All these people were on fate's chessboard, and he had once been one of them too—a chess piece manipulated by the Heavenly Way. But now, he had the chance to become the one who plays the game.

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) If I choose the first path, I can avenge everyone who hurt me, make Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, and the Holy Sect all kneel at my feet... but will I still be able to remember Xiaonian? Will I still remember Su Qingyao's eyes when she blocked that sword for me?

text.content: He closed his eyes, and the scene of Chen Tianming's death played in his mind. That aged figure, using the last strand of his strength, had passed the Tianji Record inheritance to him, his voice hoarse but firm: "Chen Ji, remember, the Tianji Record was never meant to make you become the new Heavenly Way, but to let you break this damned fate."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji stood at fate's crossroads, his heart raging between the temptation of power and the adherence to his original intention. Though Mister Mo's residual soul had fallen into slumber, Chen Tianming's dying wish was branded into the depths of his heart. How should he decide?

choices.text: Choose to Replace the Heavenly Way
choices.description: Become the new Heavenly Way consciousness, control the life and death of all things, and avenge everyone who once despised me. This is the most direct path to power, but also the loneliest throne.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all human emotions and memories
choices.visible_reward: Gain the power to control the Heavenly Way
choices.risk_hint: You will no longer be Chen Ji, but an eternal and lonely Heavenly Way

text.content: Crimson light erupted from the inscription like a sea of blood surging forth. Chen Ji felt unprecedented power flooding into his body—that was the authority over life and death of all things, the might towering above everything. However, at the same time, his memories began to blur—Su Qingyao's smile, Ye Qing's tearful eyes, Xiaonian's voice calling "Brother"—all were fading away.

choices.description: Transcend beyond the Heavenly Way, no longer bound by fate. This path is full of unknowns, but at least I can still remember who I am, remember those I love.
choices.visible_cost: Wander eternally in the Void, accepted by no world
choices.visible_reward: Completely transcend fate and become a true free being
choices.risk_hint: You will forever lose your place to return to, becoming fate's outcast

text.content: Silver-white light poured down like moon radiance, enveloping Chen Ji's entire being. He felt his Heavenly Fate Value rapidly draining away—the chains that had bound him for millennia were breaking. Agonizing pain struck, his body began to turn transparent, as if about to dissolve into this light. However, just at this moment, a crisp voice pierced through the Void—

dialogue.content: (Chen Nian's voice echoed from the distant Void) Brother... I see it, I see you standing before the inscription... Don't forget who you are, don't forget our promise!

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes suddenly moistened. That was his missing sister's voice, an echo that refused to fade from his mind through countless nights of startled awakening. Xiaonian... His Xiaonian was still alive, still worrying about him somewhere. He abruptly opened his eyes, gazing at the fragmented inscription, and an unprecedented determination surged in his heart.

dialogue.content: (Voice low and firm) Mister Mo, Father... I understand now. The Tianji Record was never meant to make mortals become the Heavenly Way, but to break the chains the Heavenly Way imposed on mortals. I don't need to become a new sovereign—I only need to break all of this!

text.content: As the words fell, those two options on the inscription shattered abruptly, dissolving into countless scattered lights. At the same time, entirely new characters emerged from the depths of the inscription—that was the third possibility, written in ancient script Chen Ji had never seen—an independent path, transcending beyond both Heavenly Way and the mortal realm, carving out a new world belonging to one's own fate.

choice.prompt: The third path appeared before Chen Ji, but this path required him to pay an enormous price—completely severing his connection with the Tianji Record, thus losing the ability to foresee the future. For a person who walked the world through strategy, what would losing the Tianji Record mean?

choices.text: Accept the price, sever the connection
choices.description: Sever the connection with the Tianji Record, lose the ability to foresee the future. From now on, walk the world as a mortal, creating the future through one's own wisdom and hands.
choices.visible_cost: Permanently lose the foresight ability of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain a truly independent fate, no longer bound by anything
choices.risk_hint: After losing the Tianji Record, you will face a completely unknown world

text.content: Blood dripped from Chen Ji's wrist, soaking into that yellowed ancient book. The Tianji Record emitted one final dazzling light, then dissolved into countless stars scattering across the Void. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value rapidly draining away, those foresight images flickering through his mind like a passing show—then, all fell into darkness. He was no longer the inheritor of the Tianji Record, but an ordinary mortal.

choices.description: Retain the Tianji Record's abilities, using it as a foundation to carve out the third path. Though the risk is greater, at least there will still be the trump card of foresight to rely upon.
choices.visible_cost: Forever bound to the Tianji Record, constrained by it
choices.visible_reward: Retain foresight ability, possessing unique advantages in the new world
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record's backlash may descend at any moment

text.content: The Tianji Record's light suddenly gathered, transforming into a stream of light that sank into Chen Ji's brow center. He felt a mild yet powerful force circulating within him—that was a newborn power independent of the Heavenly Way. However, at the same time, a low sigh rang in his mind—the voice of the Eye of Heavenly Way: "Interesting... You chose the third path, but do you think this will let you escape my chessboard?"

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the complete Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with unprecedented radiance. Within that light was reflected a scene even the Eye of Heavenly Way had never anticipated—countless tiny points of light burst forth from within Chen Ji, those were the residual souls of prophecy masters throughout the ages who had been manipulated by the Heavenly Way; they had finally gained freedom at the moment the Tianji Record dissolved.

dialogue.content: (The Eye of Heavenly Way's voice resounded through the Void, carrying rare shock) Impossible... How could you break the Heavenly Fate chains I set? This violates the rules of the Heavenly Way!

(Chen Ji's voice calm yet powerful) The Heavenly Way? You are merely an existence that uses prophecy masters of every generation as chess pieces. The true meaning of the Tianji Record was never to let you manipulate fate, but to give mortals a chance to break the chains. From this day forward, I am no longer your chess piece—nor your opponent.

text.content: As the words fell, that projected will of the Eye of Heavenly Way abruptly shattered, dissolving into countless fading lights. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented lightness, as if the tremendous burden pressing on his heart had finally been lifted. He slowly opened his eyes and found himself standing in the Bamboo Grove of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the first rays of morning sunlight filtering through the bamboo leaves and falling upon him.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao's voice came from nearby, carrying irrepressible joy) Chen Ji! Are you alright? I sensed the Tianji Record's aura suddenly disappear... You—you did it?

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, looking at the woman who had fought alongside him through countless crises. In the morning light, her eyes were slightly red, clearly she had been waiting for a long time. The corners of his mouth lifted slightly, revealing a truly relaxed smile—that was a smile from the depths of his heart, after laying down all pretense and burden. From now on, he was no longer thetrash disciple who had to hide his true abilities, nor the prophecy master burdened by Heavenly Fate. He was merely Chen Ji, a person who had finally taken control of his own destiny.
